project_type: Python FastAPI monorepo with React frontend - educational platform
build_system: pip with requirements.txt (pip-compile generated hashes), Docker for deployment
test_framework: pytest with unittest.mock, AsyncMock for async services, no conftest fixtures (each test file self-contained)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest tests. 2. Verify FastAPI app imports cleanly with: python -c 'from app.main import app'
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No MongoDB or Redis running locally - tests must mock DB. No GCP credentials available - AI service calls must be mocked in tests.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: admin routes use _validate_admin_session and _csrf_check from app.api.v1.admin. Beanie Documents registered in app/db/mongo.py init_beanie call. Services use class-based pattern with module-level singleton instances.
key_patterns: 1. Models in app/models/ as Beanie Documents. 2. Services in app/services/ as classes with module-level singletons. 3. API routes in app/api/v1/ using FastAPI APIRouter. 4. Admin auth via cookie-based session validation. 5. Vertex AI client in app/services/ai/vertex_client.py with circuit breaker. 6. Content publisher indexes to Vertex Search Discovery Engine. 7. Public endpoints have no auth; admin endpoints check _validate_admin_session.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/ - FastAPI app root. app/models/ - Beanie Document models. app/services/ - business logic services. app/services/ai/ - AI client wrappers (vertex, sarvam). app/services/search/ - Vertex Search service. app/services/content/ - content pipeline, renderer, GCS. app/api/v1/ - all API routers (admin_*, public_content, content, chat, etc). app/core/ - security, rate limiter, circuit breaker. app/db/ - mongo.py and redis.py initialization.
